tui_runtime_attached_ignored: Toast of the TUI right after it attached to a running runner when the command line named services or profiles.
tui_runtime_busy: Error of `atlas dev`, `atlas dev --detach` and `atlas -- <command>` when the running atlas does not answer its control socket in time. Same sentence as cmd_link_dev_busy; fold the two when both areas are on main.
tui_runtime_config_changed: Error of `atlas dev` when it would attach to a running runner whose services differ from the current atlas.yaml.
tui_runtime_config_detected: The one line printed by `atlas dev` and its variants when the folder has no atlas.yaml and services were detected. Documented in docs/configuration.md. {names} lists the detected services.
tui_runtime_config_detected_errors: First line of the error when the config Atlas detects for a folder without atlas.yaml fails its own checks; the list of problems follows.
tui_runtime_config_detected_none: Same line as tui_runtime_config_detected when nothing was detected.
tui_runtime_config_missing: Error when a command that needs a real atlas.yaml runs in a folder without one.
tui_runtime_config_parse_failed: Cause line of a config error: atlas.yaml or atlas.local.yaml is not valid YAML. {file} is the file name; the parser's message follows.
tui_runtime_config_read_failed: Cause line of a config error: reading atlas.yaml or atlas.local.yaml failed. {file} is the file name.
tui_runtime_deps_failed: Console line of `atlas dev --headless` and the runner when the `pre_command` of atlas.yaml failed; a red cross comes before it. {reason} is the failure.
tui_runtime_deps_installed: Console line of `atlas dev --headless` and the runner after the `pre_command` installed the project's dependencies; a green check comes before it.
tui_runtime_down_busy_unknown_pid: Error of `atlas down` when the running atlas answers busy with no pid, so nothing can be waited on.
tui_runtime_down_refused: Error of `atlas down` when the runner answers the shutdown request with a refusal and no reason.
tui_runtime_in_terminal_pid: Error of `atlas dev --detach` when a TUI owns the project and cannot hand it to a runner. {pid} is the TUI's pid.
tui_runtime_keep_session: Printed when the person answered no to tui_runtime_kill_confirm.
tui_runtime_kill_confirm: Question of the prompt shown when another TUI owns the project; the capital letter is the default (no). The accepted yes answers are y, yes, s and sim in every language.
tui_runtime_leave_detached: Line printed after an attached TUI closes without stopping the runner. The commands are part of the line.
tui_runtime_leave_still_stopping: Line printed after the TUI closes when the runner did not exit in 20 seconds.
tui_runtime_leave_stopped: Line printed after the TUI closes when the runner exited.
tui_runtime_leave_stopping: Line printed after the TUI closes when the person chose to stop everything in an attached TUI.
tui_runtime_lock_log_dir: Error of `atlas dev` when the `.logs` folder of the project cannot be created. {path} is the folder, {reason} the system's error.
tui_runtime_lock_other: Error when the project's lock file is held by another atlas that this one cannot attach to.
tui_runtime_lock_running: Error of `atlas dev` when another atlas owns the project and its pid is unknown.
tui_runtime_lock_running_pid: Error of `atlas dev` when another atlas owns the project; the lock file names its pid.
tui_runtime_run_action_done: Console line of the runner when an action finished well; a green check comes before it.
tui_runtime_run_action_failed: Console line of the runner when an action failed; a red cross comes before it.
tui_runtime_run_action_line: Prefix of each output line of an atlas.yaml action run by the runner. {label} is the action's label, {line} one line of its output.
tui_runtime_run_banner: First line of `atlas dev --headless` and the runner. {mode} is the flag name: headless or runner.
tui_runtime_run_done: Last console line of `atlas dev --headless` and the runner, after every service stopped; a green check comes before it. i18n-distinct: a status line in the past, not the Done button of common_action_done (pt-BR: Concluir).
tui_runtime_run_infra_failed: Console line of `atlas dev --headless` and the runner when the infrastructure services (docker) could not start; a red cross comes before it. {names} lists them, {reason} is the engine's message.
tui_runtime_run_project: Detail line under the banner of `atlas dev --headless` and the runner: the project name.
tui_runtime_run_services: Detail line under the banner: how many services the project has.
tui_runtime_run_services_of: Detail line under the banner when the run was narrowed to some services (`atlas dev api web`); {names} lists them.
tui_runtime_run_started_detached: Line of the detached runner, in its log, after the banner. {command} is `atlas down`.
tui_runtime_run_started_foreground: Line of `atlas dev --headless`, in the foreground, after the banner. {key} is the interrupt key (Ctrl+C).
tui_runtime_run_stopping: Console line of `atlas dev --headless` and the runner when they stop the services.
tui_runtime_run_tunnel: Console line of `atlas dev --headless` and the runner when the SSH tunnel changes state; {state} is a service state label.
tui_runtime_runner_exited: First line of the error of `atlas dev --detach` when the detached runner died at once; the last lines of its log follow. {status} is the exit status, {path} the runner log.
tui_runtime_runner_no_socket: Error of `atlas dev --detach` when the runner started but never answered. {path} is the runner log.
tui_runtime_running_notice: First line of the prompt shown when another TUI owns the project. {pid} is its pid; tui_runtime_kill_confirm follows on the next line.
tui_runtime_state_degraded: State of a service in the TUI service menu and the `atlas dev` console lines: it answers, but its readiness probe fails or the same error repeats.
tui_runtime_state_disabled: State of a service in the TUI service menu and the `atlas dev` console lines: stopped by hand or left out of this run.
tui_runtime_state_failed: State of a service in the TUI service menu and the `atlas dev` console lines: it exited with an error or gave up restarting.
tui_runtime_state_running: State of a service in the TUI service menu and the `atlas dev` console lines: up and answering.
tui_runtime_state_starting: State of a service in the TUI service menu and the `atlas dev` console lines: the process was launched and is not up yet.
tui_runtime_state_stopped: State of a service in the TUI service menu, the `atlas dev` console lines and the footer: not running, stopped on purpose or finished.
tui_runtime_state_suspended: State of a service in the TUI service menu and the `atlas dev` console lines: paused on purpose by an action (iOS or Android dev), not an error.
tui_runtime_state_unhealthy: State of a service in the TUI service menu and the `atlas dev` console lines: the process is alive but stopped answering its health check.
